question: Can materially relevant relationship salience become visible while remaining distinct from creator selection, Director opportunity, obligation, relationship ontology/score, emotional diagnosis and a permanent graph?
accepted_grammar: Relationship salience is an orthogonal Stage meaning and may be shown only when materially supported.
Creator selection remains independent: Marlowe stays selected in both comparison specimens.
Director opportunity remains independent: Iona retains current opportunity in both specimens.
Speaking/listening and Character identity remain unchanged while Dr. Voss + Wren alone become the relationship-salience witness.
Relationship salience does not imply relationship type, strength, score, reciprocity, permanence, obligation or emotional diagnosis.
A quiet compositional/shared-floor-field witness can demonstrate capacity without making a node-link graph the Stage model.

recursive_audit.isolation_check: PASS - selection, opportunity, speaking/listening, identity and Scene context remain constant across the pair; only relationship salience changes.

explicit_non_authority: No relationship ontology, direction, reciprocity, permanence, causal-effect score or psychological model is established.
No graph, line, arc, pip, connector, shared-floor field or geometry is frozen as the final relationship treatment.
No salience algorithm, automatic grouping, selection coupling, opportunity coupling, transcript trigger or provider behavior is established.
No Stage successor, transcript-dependent motion, final palette/type/iconography or native implementation authority is created.
next_boundary: Resolve the remaining static-safe performance-modality gap: demonstrate nonverbal action and refusal as Character-legible performance without transcript-first UI or invented motive/timing semantics.
approval: APPROVED BY STANDING DIRECTOR DELEGATION — CLEAN RECURSIVE AUDIT.
